name: Kneeling Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent, hips stacked and the lower elbow beneath your shoulder.
Press your forearm and lower knee into the floor to raise your hips until shoulders, hips and knees line up.
Hold this position while breathing evenly, then lower your hips and switch sides.
tips: Keep your chest facing forward so the upper shoulder stays over the lower one.
Push the floor away through your forearm to keep your shoulder clear of your ear.
